description: Declare the files you will change BEFORE writing any of them. Returns the impact (every route that renders those files, transitively) and opens a transaction; writes to undeclared files fail verification. Takes a "before" render of affected routes (may take ~30-60s on a cold project). Need another file mid-edit? Call again with amend=<txId> and only the extra files.

amend.description: txId of the open edit to add files to.

refactor.description: A change that must not show: extracting components, replacing hardcoded values with equal tokens, renames. Every affected page must then render pixel-identically, and nothing visible is expected to change.

root.description: Absolute project root. Defaults to the project this server was started for.

scope.description: tokens: design tokens in the stylesheet. component: one shared component, every consumer changes. variant: an opt-in prop on a shared component, set only on some pages; other consumers must render identically. page: one page only. new-component: a new shared block (check the inventory for one with the same PURPOSE first). design-system: only component previews (<name>.preview.tsx next to a component) for the /design-system viewer.

target.description: What the user addressed: a component ID (CID-007), an exact component name (@KpiCard), or a token (--radius). Its file is added to modify, and the scope must fit it.
